summary: Russia launched a massive coordinated wave of Shahed and Geran-5 drones across northern and central Ukraine targeting energy infrastructure and population centers, while guided aerial bombs struck Sumy city infrastructure. Ukrainian forces reportedly struck a major logistics center in Russia's Adygeysk region. Russian ground forces advanced in Kostiantynivka amid expanding drone-assault doctrine adoption by Ukrainian units.
key_points: Over 50 Shahed and Geran-5 drones launched from multiple axes targeting Kyiv, Poltava, Chernihiv, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
Three Russian KAB guided bombs hit Sumy's Kovpakivskyi district damaging infrastructure with no reported casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/128686)
Ukrainian UAV attack ignited fire at Ozon logistics center in Adygeysk, Russia, with blaze ongoing. (Source: @UkraineNow/85105)
Russian drones struck Kovel substation and targeted three substations critical for Khmelnytskyi NPP operation. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77914)
Shahed drones circled Kyiv's CHP-6 thermal plant in Desnianskyi district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77932)
Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat detected from Taganrog, Rostov region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77913)
DeepState map confirms Russian advance in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23974)
225th Assault Battalion now executes 50% of infantry tasks via drones, developing integrated drone-assault doctrine. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23976)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale multi-axis drone offensive employing Shahed and Geran-5 systems against energy and urban targets across central and northern Ukraine, complemented by KAB strikes on Sumy. Ukrainian long-range strike capability demonstrated with attack on Russian logistics hub in Adygeysk. Russian ground forces gained ground in Kostiantynivka while Ukrainian units accelerate drone-centric assault doctrine.

points: Ukrainian long-range UAV struck Ozon logistics center in Adygeysk, Krasnodar Krai, causing significant fire at major e-commerce warehouse facility. (Source: @UkraineNow/85105)

225th Separate Assault Battalion (225 ОШП) has transitioned to drone-assault doctrine with 50% of infantry tasks now performed by UAVs, integrating aerial reconnaissance, FPV strikes, and ground robotic systems. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23976)

Ukrainian air defense tracking networks (eRadar, mon1tor, kpszsu) provided real-time detection of over 50 inbound Shahed/Geran-5 drones and multiple Geran-5 cruise missiles across 10+ oblasts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
Fundraising campaign initiated for 4 fiber-optic FPV drones for HUR MOU (Main Intelligence Directorate), though only 7,800 UAH of 100,000 UAH target collected. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77941)

Russian forces launched massive coordinated drone wave: 15 Shaheds from Kharkiv to Poltava, 12 from Sumy to Chernihiv, 9 from Chernihiv to Kyiv, plus multiple Geran-5 missiles targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
Three KAB guided aerial bombs struck Sumy city's Kovpakivskyi district hitting infrastructure objects; Sumy MVA reported no casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/128686)

Geran-5 missile struck Kovel substation (energy infrastructure) in Volyn region; three drones attacked substations critical for Khmelnytskyi NPP operation prompting IAEA notification. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77914, @UkraineNow/85102)

Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat detected from Taganrog, Rostov region; Shahed drones targeted Kyiv's CHP-6 thermal plant in Desnianskyi district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77913, @mon1tor_ua/77932)
Banderoil-type UAVs operated from Bryansk region into Chernihiv oblast and from multiple directions toward Nizhyn, Nosivka, and Kyiv reservoir area. (Source: @eRadarrua/128695, @eRadarrua/128662)
Russian forces advanced in Kostiantynivka (Donetsk oblast) per DeepState map update indicating continued pressure on this sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23974)
Reactive UAV activity detected in Donetsk region (1 group) per eRadar monitoring. (Source: @eRadarrua/128689)
Geran-5 missile launched from Luhansk region toward Rostov region, Russia, suggesting possible Ukrainian strike from occupied territory or Russian friendly fire incident. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77935)
KAB guided bomb strikes on Sumy city (northern Donetsk vicinity) demonstrate continued Russian use of glide bombs against frontline urban centers. (Source: @eRadarrua/128686)

Intense UAV activity across Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv oblasts: Banderoil UAVs from Bryansk to Chernihiv, toward Nizhyn (2), Nosivka; reactive UAVs past Kulikivka westbound, past Vovchansk (Kharkiv), past Sumy from north. (Source: @eRadarrua/128695, @kpszsu/93119, @kpszsu/93120, @kpszsu/93109)
Sumy city struck by 3 KABs hitting Kovpakivskyi district infrastructure; reactive guided UAV toward Romny; UAV on Sumy from north. (Source: @eRadarrua/128686, @eRadarrua/128643)

Massive Shahed launch from Kharkiv region: 15 Shaheds to Poltava (Poltava district), 10 to Poltava (Lubny district), 5 to Poltava (Poltava district) in subsequent waves. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915, @mon1tor_ua/77938)

Chernihiv region targeted by Banderoil UAVs from east and south; 2 Shaheds on Chernihiv from north; 9 Shaheds from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Boryspil district). (Source: @eRadarrua/128662, @mon1tor_ua/77912, @mon1tor_ua/77935)
Reactive UAV detected approaching Odesa from Black Sea; reactive UAV south of Kropyvnytskyi heading west; reactive UAVs west of Mykolaiv heading north. (Source: @kpszsu/93106, @kpszsu/93110)
Geran-5 missile from Black Sea aquatory on Mykolaiv-Odesa border; reactive Shahed from Kherson region to Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)
KAB launches reported toward Chornomorska, Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77944)
Shahed drone targeted Voznesensk, Mykolaiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915)

Multi-wave drone offensive: 10+ Shaheds from Kharkiv to Poltava, 12 from Sumy to Chernihiv, 9 from Chernihiv to Kyiv, 14 from Cherkasy/Kyiv to Kirovohrad, 5 from Kharkiv to Poltava, 2 from Cherkasy to Kirovohrad, 2 from Poltava to Cherkasy, plus individual Shaheds on Kyiv, Brovary, Bila Tserkva, Cherkasy, Rivne, Dnipro, Kropyvnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77915, @mon1tor_ua/77938, @mon1tor_ua/77935)

Geran-5 cruise missile strikes: 2 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod), 1 from Kyiv to Zhytomyr (Korosten), 1 from Odesa to Vinnytsia (Haisyn), 1 from Mykolaiv to Vinnytsia (Haisyn), 1 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi, 1 from Zhytomyr to Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka), 4 on Rivne, 5 from Zhytomyr to Rivne (Sarny), 1 from Rivne to Volyn (Lutsk), 1 from Kirovohrad to Vinnytsia (Haisyn), 1 from Kyiv to Zhytomyr (Korosten), 1 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Kamianets-Podilskyi). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77912, @mon1tor_ua/77938, @mon1tor_ua/77935, @mon1tor_ua/77915)

Reactive Shaheds: 1 on Dnipro, 3 on Dnipro, 2 on Kropyvnytskyi, 1 on Brovary, 1 on Bilohorodka/Chaiky, 1 from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, 1 from Kherson to Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77912, @mon1tor_ua/77946, @mon1tor_ua/77927, @mon1tor_ua/77943, @mon1tor_ua/77915)

Banderoil UAVs: 2 on Nizhyn from east, 1 from south, 1 toward Nosivka from east, 1 north of Chernihiv westbound, 1 past Kulikivka westbound, 1 from Chernihiv toward Kyiv reservoir/Chornobyl. (Source: @eRadarrua/128662, @eRadarrua/128664, @kpszsu/93087, @kpszsu/93119, @kpszsu/93115)
Kyiv air raid alert ended 15:56 04.11.2026 after Banderoil-triggered alarm. (Source: @eRadarrua/128669)
